fields.v: A single Markdown configuration file read by Claude Code for each request: bash commands, code style, workflow guidelines, project structure (Fig. 1 example). Observed concerns (Fig. 2, text): Software Architecture 72.6% (238 files), Development Guidelines 44.8%, Project Overview 39%, Testing 35.4%, Commands 33.2%, Dependencies 30.8%, General Guidelines 25.6%, Integration and Usage Guidelines 18% each, Configuration 17.4%. 45 files were 'memory banks' pointing to other Markdown files
